body:
Ok, I always hear that when you do coke it makes you instantly addicted. I went to my friends house and he bought 120 dollars worth of coke and I did 2 lines and every one else did a total of about 10 each. They don't even crave any more and I didn't either. It was pretty fun and cool though. I loved talking to people when I was on it but it also made me really calm. That is probably because I didn't do enough. It kind of made me sick to my stomach, and kind of gave me a headache. It made me really numb. the next day I did 2 more lines, and it had almost no effect. The only thing it did was make my throat numb and it made me want to chain smoke so I smoked like 6 or 7 cigarettes one after another, which is weird because I'm only 15 and I'm not even really a smoker.
